record.field: select ks.ktokd, t.trucknr, b.posnr,a.vbeln as nomor_do, a.erdat, so.vbeln AS sales_order_no, vbkd.inco1 as delivery_method, ks.name1 AS sold_to_name, so.kunnr AS sold_to_code, ksh.name1 AS ship_to_name, a.kunnr AS ship_to_code, b.werks, b.lgort, b.matnr, m.maktx AS product_description, c.vrkme AS sales_order_uom, b.vrkme AS delivery_uom, b.lfimg AS delivery_qty, mara.meins AS base_uom, marm.umrez AS uom_numerator, marm.umren AS uom_denominator, a.ernam from likp a JOIN lips b ON a.vbeln = b.vbeln JOIN vbak so ON b.vgbel = so.vbeln JOIN vbap c ON b.vgbel = c.vbeln AND b.vgpos = c.posnr LEFT JOIN vbkd ON vbkd.vbeln = so.vbeln AND vbkd.posnr = '000000' JOIN kna1 ks ON so.kunnr = ks.kunnr JOIN kna1 ksh ON a.kunnr = ksh.kunnr LEFT JOIN makt m ON b.matnr = m.matnr AND m.spras = 'E' LEFT JOIN mara ON b.matnr = mara.matnr LEFT JOIN marm ON marm.matnr = b.matnr AND marm.meinh = c.vrkme left join zmm_ts_sl_bgd t on a.vbeln = t.vbeln where t.vbeln != ' ' and TO_DATE(a.erdat,'YYYYMMDD') between CURRENT_DATE-7 and CURRENT_DATE AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ZMM_TS_SCHDR s where t.werks = s.werks and t.seqnr = s.seqnr and t.trucknr = s.trucknr and t.arrdate = s.arrdate)

select c.vgpos, e.ebeln, c.posnr, a.vbeln_vl, a.arrdate, a.trucknr, a.werks, a.lgort, b.kunnr, c.matnr, c.lfimg, c.vrkme, d.umrez, d.umren, b.ernam from zmm_ts_sto a join likp b on a.vbeln_vl=b.vbeln join lips c on b.vbeln=c.vbeln left join marm d on c.matnr=d.matnr and c.vrkme=d.meinh left join ekko e on e.ebeln=a.ebeln where exists (select 1 from zmm_ts_arr_pool x where x.trucknr=a.trucknr and x.srctab='ZMM_TS_OSTO_NCPL') and exists (select 1 from ekpo f where f.ebeln=c.vgbel and f.pstyp='7')
SELECT a.mblnr,a.le_vbeln,a.budat,a.cputm, a.usnam from mkpf a join likp b on a.xblnr = b.vbeln

UPDATE zmm_ts_arr_pool a SET w_odoo = 'X' WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zmm_ts_sto b WHERE a.werks = b.werks AND a.seqnr = b.seqnr AND a.trucknr = b.trucknr AND a.arrdate = b.arrdate AND b.vbeln_vl IN ({vbeln}))

UPDATE zmm_ts_arr_pool a SET w_odoo = 'X' WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ZMM_TS_STO_NCD b WHERE a.werks = b.werks AND a.seqnr = b.seqnr AND a.trucknr = b.trucknr AND a.arrdate = b.arrdate AND b.ebeln IN ({po_sap}))

UPDATE zmm_ts_arr_pool a SET w_odoo = 'X' WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zmm_ts_sl_bgd b WHERE a.werks = b.werks AND a.seqnr = b.seqnr AND a.trucknr = b.trucknr AND a.arrdate = b.arrdate AND b.vbeln IN ({do_sap}))

UPDATE zmm_ts_arr_pool a SET w_odoo = 'X' WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ZMM_TS_STO_NCD b WHERE a.werks = b.werks AND a.seqnr = b.seqnr AND a.trucknr = b.trucknr AND a.arrdate = b.arrdate AND b.ebeln IN ({po_sto}))

UPDATE zmm_ts_arr_pool a SET w_odoo = 'X' WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zmm_ts_in_po b WHERE a.werks = b.werks AND a.seqnr = b.seqnr AND a.trucknr = b.trucknr AND a.arrdate = b.arrdate AND b.donr IN ({partner_ref}))

UPDATE zmm_ts_arr_pool a SET w_odoo = 'X' WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ZMM_TS_STO b WHERE a.werks = b.werks AND a.seqnr = b.seqnr AND a.trucknr = b.trucknr AND a.arrdate = b.arrdate AND b.vbeln_vl IN ({do_sap}))
select a.erdat, a.vbeln, a.mblnr, a.matnr, a.lfimg from ztp_git a where a.mblnr != ' ' and a.lgort_to = 'GIT' and a.lfimg != 0

SELECT a.werks, a.seqnr, a.trucknr, a.arrdate, a.ebeln, a.ebelp, a.matnr, a.qtypo, a.uoe, a.erfmg, a.meins, d.umren, d.umrez,c.slocto as kesloc,c.slocfrom as darisloc FROM ZMM_TS_STO_NCD a JOIN zmm_ts_arr_pool b ON a.werks = b.werks AND a.seqnr = b.seqnr AND a.trucknr = b.trucknr AND a.arrdate = b.arrdate JOIN ZMM_TS_STO_NCH c ON a.werks = c.werks AND a.seqnr = c.seqnr AND a.trucknr = c.trucknr AND a.arrdate = c.arrdate JOIN MARM d ON a.matnr = d.matnr AND a.uoe = d.meinh WHERE b.srctab = 'ZMM_TS_OSTO_NCSL' and b.w_odoo = ' '
